```artifact
Feature: System Availability and Data Management

  Scenario: System Availability
    Given the system is operational
    When the current day is the 2nd Sunday of the month
    Then the system should have an outage window of 10 minutes

  Scenario Outline: Nightly Full Backup
    Given the system is operational
    When the time is <time>
    Then a full backup should be initiated
    Examples:
      | time       | kind     |
      | 23:59:59   | positive |
      | 00:00:00   | positive |
      | 23:59:00   | boundary |
      | 00:01:00   | boundary |

  Scenario Outline: Monthly Rollback Provision
    Given the system is operational
    When a rollback request is made
    Then the system should rollback to the state from <days> days ago
    Examples:
      | days | kind     |
      | 30   | positive |
      | 29   | boundary |
      | 31   | boundary |

  Scenario Outline: Daily Backup Restoration on Dummy System
    Given the system is operational
    When a backup is completed at <time>
    Then the backup should be restored on the dummy production system
    Examples:
      | time       | kind     |
      | 01:00:00   | positive |
      | 00:59:59   | boundary |
      | 02:00:00   | boundary |

  Scenario: Dummy Production Database Purge Post-Restoration
    Given the backup has been restored on the dummy production system
    When the restoration process is complete
    Then the dummy production database should be purged

  Scenario: Data Storage in Fireproof Cabinet
    Given the system data is stored in Mangalore HQ
    When the data storage location is checked
    Then the data should be in a fireproof cabinet 25 KM away from the Hospital

  Scenario: Compliance with Health Care Regulations
    Given the system is operational
    When the system compliance is verified
    Then the system should comply with health care regulations as defined by Government of India
```
